script: The US secretly recruited Nazi scientists after the war, and hid their past for decades. In 1945, American officials found German rocket engineers who had built weapons for Hitler, and instead of prosecuting them, they offered them new lives. Their records were quietly rewritten, their Nazi party membership scrubbed from the files handed to the public. Hundreds were brought to America under new identities, given laboratories, salaries, and a fresh start. The program stayed classified for over thirty years. When it finally came out, the government admitted what it had erased was real, and had been real the entire time. The US had secretly recruited Nazi scientists, and hidden their past for decades.
